reason: Close a delayed-message lookahead path in pressure aggregation and recovery observation.

causality.pressure_inputs: a force-order or aggregate-trade row enters a window only when its receivedAt is no later than that window end; otherwise it is excluded from that window
causality.recovery_observation: the recovery book must be received no earlier than the five-second target and no later than two seconds after the target
causality.recording: late rows remain in the raw capture and are reported as data-quality exclusions; they are not silently shifted into another window
